群的需求。

is located in prime location or high potential area
in Tier 1&2 cities, meets consumers’ needs in their
pursuits for good taste fashions.

passion, is located in regional center area in Tier 1&2
cities or prime location in Tier 3 cities.

offers bigger outdoor space and closer integration
with local culture and spirit.

     公平值計量                                  FAIR VALUE MEASUREMENT

     公平值為於計量當日在市場參與者之間於有                    Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or
     序交易中出售資產所收取或轉讓負債所支付                    paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between
     的價格，不管該價格是否可直接觀察得到或                    market participants at the measurement date, regardless of
     使用另一估值技巧而估計。於估計資產或負                    whether that price is directly observable or estimated using
     債的公平值時，倘市場參與者於計量當日為                    another valuation technique. In estimating the fair value of an
     資產或負債定價時將會考慮的資產或負債的                    asset or a liability, the Group takes into account the
     特點時，則本集團會考慮該等特點。                       characteristics of the asset or liability if market participants
                                            would take those characteristics into account when pricing the
                                            asset or liability at the measurement date.

     非金融資產公平值之計量則參考市場參與者                    A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
     可從使用該資產得到之最高及最佳效用，或                    account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
     把該資產售予另一可從使用該資產得到最高                    benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by
     及最佳效用之市場參與者所產生之經濟效益。                   selling it to another market participant that would use the asset
                                            in its highest and best use.

     一般方法                                   General approach

     預期信貸虧損分兩個階段確認。就自初次確                    ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for
     認起未有大幅增加的信貸風險而言，預期信                    which there has not been a significant increase in credit risk
     貸虧損就由未來 12 個月內可能發生違約事                  since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that
     件而導致的信貸虧損計提撥備（12 個月預期                  result from default events that are possible within the next 12
     信貸虧損）。就自初次確認起大幅增加的信                    months (a 12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for which
     貸風險而言，不論發生違約時間，均須就於                    there has been a significant increase in credit risk since initial
     餘下風險年期內的預期信貸虧損計提虧損撥                    recognition, a loss allowance is required for credit losses
     備（全期預期信貸虧損）。                           expected over the remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of
                                            the timing of the default (a lifetime ECL).

     本集團於各報告日期評估金融工具的信貸風                    At each reporting date, the Group assesses whether the credit
     險是否自初次確認以來大幅增加。進行評估                    risk on a financial instrument has increased significantly since
     時，本集團比較於報告日期金融工具發生違                    initial recognition. When making the assessment, the Group
     約的風險與於初次確認日期金融工具發生違                    compares the risk of a default occurring on the financial
     約的風險，並考慮毋須付出過多成本或努力                    instrument as at the reporting date with the risk of a default
     即可取得的合理可靠資料，包括歷史及前瞻                    occurring on the financial instrument as at the date of initial
     性資料。                                   recognition and considers reasonable and supportable
                                            information that is available without undue cost or effort,
                                            including historical and forward-looking information.

     本集團於合約付款逾期 45 日時將金融資產                  The Group considers a financial asset in default when
     視為已違約。然而，在若干情況下，本集團                    contractual payments are 45 days past due. However, in certain
     亦於有內部或外界資料顯示本集團不可能悉                    cases, the Group may also consider a financial asset to be in
     數收取未償還合約金額（未計及本集團所持                    default when internal or external information indicates that the
     任何信貸加強措施）時，將金融資產視為已                    Group is unlikely to receive the outstanding contractual
     違約。                                    amounts in full before taking into account any credit

     時，則須作出利率估計。當可觀察輸入數據                      do not enter into financing transactions) or when it needs to be

       之有關法例而定。當本集團履約並無                     the laws that apply to the contract. It is satisfied over time

       項時，履約責任於一段時間內達成，                     right to payment for performance completed to date,
       否則於客戶取得已落成物業的實際擁                     otherwise, it is satisfied at the point in time when
       有權或法定所有權且本集團很有可能                     customers obtain the physical possession or the legal title

        益法及╱或直接比較法，在建物業所用的剩餘                        approach and/or direct comparison approach for completed properties
        法、直接比較法及╱或成本法，以及使用權資                        and residual approach, direct comparison approach and/or cost
        產所用之收益法。                                    approach for the properties under construction and income approach
                                                    for the right-of-use assets.

        收益法通過計算物業當前租約的租金收入，並                        The income approach operates by taking into account the rental
        計算出租及空置部份的潛在租金收入，然後按                        income of the property derived from the existing tenancies with due
        合適的資本化率將其資本化為價值。                            allowance for the potential reversionary income of the tenanted and
                                                    vacant portions, which are then capitalised at an appropriate
                                                    capitalisation rate.

        直接比較法涉及分析近期巿場上同類型物業的                        The direct comparison approach involves the analysis of recent market
        案例並與該等估值物業進行比較。選取面積大                        evidence of similar properties and comparing them with the premises
        小、屬性及位置類近的可資比較物業進行分                         under valuation. Comparable properties with similar sizes, characters
        析，並仔細權衡各物業的優劣之處，從而達至                        and locations are analysed, and carefully weighed against all
        公允的評估價值。                                    respective advantage and disadvantages of each property in order to
                                                    arrive at a fair comparison of value.

        剩餘法考慮總發展價值並扣除尚未發生的建築                        The residual approach takes into account the residual value of the
        成本、開支以及發展利潤後的剩餘價值。剩餘                        gross development value (“GDV”) after deduction of the outstanding
        法首先計算假設建議發展項目於估值日已落成                        construction costs and expenses as well as profit element. It involves
        的合計總發展價值。建議發展項目的估計成本                        firstly the assessment of the aggregate GDV of the proposed
        包括建築成本、市場推廣支出、專業費用、財                        development, as if completed, as at the valuation date. Estimated
        務費用以及相關成本，另加發展商的風險及利                        costs of the proposed development include construction costs,
        潤撥備。尚未發生的開發成本將由總發展價值                        marketing expense, professional fee, finance charges and associated
        中扣除，並得出標的物業的剩餘價值。                           costs, plus an allowance for the developer’s risk and profit. The

                                                    the resultant figure is the residual value of the subject property.

  現金產生單位的可收回金額乃根據使用價值                    The recoverable amounts of the CGUs have been determined
  計算釐定。該等計算使用基於高級管理層批                    based on a value in use calculation using cash flow projections
  准的五年期現金產生單位財務預算的現金流                    based on financial budgets covering a five-year period approved
  量預測。超過五年期的現金流量使用 2.5%                  by senior management. Cash flows beyond the five-year period
  增長率進行推算。增長率不超過現金產生單                    are extrapolated using a growth rate of 2.5%. The growth rates
  位經營所在相關行業的長期平均增長率。現                    do not exceed the long-term average growth rate for the
  金流量預測所採用的稅前貼現率為 11.2% 至                related industry in which the CGUs operate. The pre-tax
  15.2%，此貼現率反映了與相關行業及現金                  discount rates applied to the cash flow projections was 11.2%
  產生單位本身的特定風險。                           to 15.2%, which reflect specific risks relating to the relevant
                                         industry and the CGUs themselves.



  本集團於各年末對商譽進行減值評估，而可                    The Group assessed the impairment on goodwill at the end of
  收回金額超過賬面金額，因此商譽不被視為                    each year and the recoverable amounts exceeded carrying
  減值。鑒於據評估有足夠的淨空，本集團認                    amounts, and hence the goodwill was not regarded as impaired.
  為關鍵參數的合理可能變動不會導致現金產                    Considering that there was sufficient headroom based on the
  生單位的賬面金額超過其可收回金額。                      assessment, the Group believed that a reasonably possible
                                         change in key parameters would not cause the carrying
                                         amounts of the CGUs to exceed their recoverable amounts.

50. 資本風險管理                               50. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT

  本集團管理資本以確保本集團各實體可以持                       The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the
  續經營，並通過優化債務及權益結餘為股東                       Group will be able to continue as a going concern while
  帶來最大回報。本集團之整體策略與上年度                       maximising the return to shareholders through the optimisation
  保持一致。                                     of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s overall strategy
                                            remains unchanged from the prior year.

  本集團之資本架構包括淨債務（包括於附註                       The capital structure of the Group consists of net debts, which
  36 披露之銀行及其他借貸、附註 37 披露之                   include the bank and other borrowings disclosed in note 36, the
  優先票據及於附註 38 披露之中期票據，扣                     senior notes disclosed in note 37 and medium-term notes
  除現金及現金等值）、應付關聯方款項、應                       disclosed in note 38, net of cash and cash equivalents, amount
  付非控股權益款項以及本公司擁有人應佔權                       due to related parties, amounts due to non-controlling interests
  益（包括已發行股本、其他儲備及永續資本                       and equity attributable to owners of the Company, comprising
  工具）。                                      issued share capital, and other reserves and perpetual capital
                                            instrument.

  本公司董事定期檢討資本架構。於檢討時，                       The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a
  董事考慮資本成本及與各資本類別相關之風                       regular basis. As part of this review, the directors consider the
  險。根據董事之建議，本集團將透過支付股                       cost of capital and the risks associated with each class of capital.
  息、發行新股、購回股份及發行新債務或贖                       Based on recommendations of the directors, the Group will
  回現有債務，平衡整體資本架構。                           balance its overall capital structure through the payment of
                                            dividends, new share issues and share buy-backs as well as the
